step1_analysis.description: A lumped-element pi-model representing an on-chip spiral inductor, including series inductance, series resistance, feedforward capacitance, and substrate parasitics. This is typically used for RF matching networks or harmonic terminations in power amplifiers.

paper_reference.title: A CMOS RF Power Amplifier With Parallel Amplification for Efficient Power Control

Inductance.description: Effective inductance at the operating frequency (1.4 GHz).

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the physical dimensions of the spiral inductor. For a typical RF matching inductor at 1.4 GHz, L is usually in the low nH range.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical values for on-chip RF inductors in the 1-2 GHz band used for PA matching or chokes.

Quality_Factor.description: Quality factor (Q) at the operating frequency, representing the ratio of energy stored to energy dissipated.

sky130_expected.calculation: Q = imag(Z) / real(Z). Depends on metal thickness and substrate resistivity.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 thick metal layers typically yield Q factors around 8-12 at low GHz frequencies.

Self_Resonant_Frequency.description: The frequency at which the inductor resonates with its own parasitic capacitance, transitioning from inductive to capacitive.

sky130_expected.reasoning: For a 2nH inductor with ~100fF parasitic capacitance, SRF is around 11 GHz, well above the 1.4 GHz operating frequency.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the effective inductance, quality factor at 1.4 GHz, and the self-resonant frequency (SRF) of the inductor pi-model using a 1-port Z-parameter setup.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Inductor Pi-Model Characterization Testbench

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Define the DUT as a subcircuit to pass parameters cleanly without modifying the original netlist syntax
.subckt ind_pi IN OUT GND Ls=2n Rs=2 Cs=50f Cox=100f Rsi=50 Csi=50f
LS IN N1 Ls
RS N1 OUT Rs
CS IN OUT Cs
Cox1 IN N2 Cox
RSi1 N2 GND Rsi
CSi1 N2 GND Csi
Cox2 OUT N3 Cox
RSi2 N3 GND Rsi
CSi2 N3 GND Csi
.ends

* Instantiate the DUT
* Port 2 (OUT) is grounded for 1-port Z-parameter measurement
X1 IN 0 0 ind_pi

* AC Current Source at Port 1 (IN)
* 1A AC current makes v(IN) directly equal to Z11
IIN 0 IN AC 1

.control
* Sweep from 100 MHz to 20 GHz to capture 1.4 GHz and SRF
ac dec 100 100MEG 20G

* Calculate Z11, Inductance, and Q
let Z11 = v(IN)
let L_ind = imag(Z11) / (2 * pi * frequency)
let Q_ind = imag(Z11) / real(Z11)

* Measure metrics at 1.4 GHz (operating frequency from paper)
meas ac L_1_4G find L_ind at=1.4G
meas ac Q_1_4G find Q_ind at=1.4G

* Measure Self-Resonant Frequency (where Q crosses 0, transitioning from inductive to capacitive)
meas ac SRF when Q_ind=0 fall=1

print L_1_4G Q_1_4G SRF
quit
.endc
.end
